// Extract Claude's text response const claudeResp = $('Claude — Generate KPI Summary').item.json; const summary = claudeResp?.content?.[0]?.text || 'Summary generation failed — check Claude API key.'; const d = $('Code — Merge & Prepare Data').item.json; // Build plain-text email body const plain = `DAILY KPI REPORT — ${d.readable_date}\n${'='.repeat(50)}\n\n${summary}\n\n${'─'.repeat(40)}\nQuick Metrics\n${'─'.repeat(40)}\nNew executions logged : ${d.exec_count}\nTotal all-time : ${d.total_all_time}\nSuccess rate : ${d.success_rate}%\nAvg duration : ${d.avg_duration}s\nNew leads (24h) : ${d.new_leads}\nHot leads : ${d.hot_leads}\n\nGenerated automatically by Enterprise AI Workflow Automation`; // Build HTML email const html = `

📊 Daily KPI Report

${d.readable_date}

🤖 AI Executive Summary

${summary}

📊 Key Metrics

Metric Value
Executions logged (yesterday) ${d.exec_count}
All-time executions ${d.total_all_time}
Success rate ${d.success_rate}%
Avg execution duration ${d.avg_duration}s
New leads (last 24h) ${d.new_leads}
Hot leads ${d.hot_leads}

Generated automatically • Enterprise AI Workflow Automation • ${d.timestamp}

`; return [{ json: { summary, plain, html, date: d.yesterday_str, readable_date: d.readable_date, exec_count: d.exec_count, new_leads: d.new_leads, success_rate: d.success_rate, hot_leads: d.hot_leads } }];

meta.description: Runs daily at 08:00. Uses only HTTP Request + Code + Gmail nodes — no native Airtable node to avoid typeVersion import issues. All Airtable calls use the REST API directly via AIRTABLE_API_KEY.

n8n_credentials_needed: Gmail OAuth2 (for the Gmail send node)

n8n_variables_needed.AIRTABLE_API_KEY: Your Airtable Personal Access Token (starts with pat...)
n8n_variables_needed.AIRTABLE_BASE_ID: Your Airtable base ID (starts with app...)
n8n_variables_needed.STAKEHOLDER_EMAILS: Email address(es) for the daily report
n8n_variables_needed.APP_BASE_URL: Your deployed backend URL, or leave blank to skip stats
